source_text: Dawoodi Bohra Women for Religious Freedom (DBWRF), established in May 2017 by women from India's Dawoodi Bohra community, campaigns to safeguard khafz—a ritual entailing the excision of the clitoral prepuce—as an integral religious and cultural observance tied to spiritual purification and hygiene. [81]
